title: Emergent Gribov horizon kernel from replica symmetry breaking in Yang--Mills theories
summary: We show that, in the replica-broken sector of the Serreau--Tissier (ST) gauge fixing, the expansion of the replica determinant in the regulator $ζ$ induces a nonlocal bilinear gluonic kernel with the same color and Lorentz structure as the quadratic part of the BRST-invariant Gribov horizon functional. This establishes an effective leading-order correspondence with the refined Gribov-Zwanziger (RGZ) horizon sector, rather than a reconstruction of the full nonlinear functional $H(A^h)$.
